claims: Mark Few is the head coach of the Gonzaga University men's basketball team.
Mark Few has led the Gonzaga University men's basketball team since 1999.
The Gonzaga University men's basketball team has made NCAA tournament appearances in every one of Mark Few's completed seasons.
Mark Few was selected for the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame Class of 2026.
Mark Few has over 773 career wins.
Mark Few was an assistant coach at Gonzaga since 1989.
Mark Few reached 500 wins third-fastest in NCAA Division I history.
Gonzaga reached the Final Four in 2017.
Gonzaga reached the Final Four in 2021.
Gonzaga men's basketball assistants in 2025-26 include Brian Michaelson.
Gonzaga men's basketball assistants in 2025-26 include R-Jay Barsh.
Gonzaga men's basketball assistants in 2025-26 include Stephen Gentry.
Lisa Fortier has been the head coach of the Gonzaga women's basketball program since April 2014
